name: Nuvama custody client queries
description: Trainer-written custody client queries for the Day 1 text classification exercise. 6 labels, 6 queries per label (participants label at least 5 per label), plus 12 unseen test messages.

labels.label: Statement request
labels.covers: Asks for a statement, report, contract note, NAV pack or other record of holdings and transactions.

labels.label: Corporate action
labels.covers: Dividends, bonus, rights, splits, buybacks, mergers, record dates and entitlements, including tax on them.

labels.label: Settlement status
labels.covers: Trades, pay-in and pay-out, delivery, short delivery, auctions, cut-off times and settlement codes.

labels.label: Fees & billing
labels.covers: Custody fees, invoices, GST on invoices, charges and fee schedules.

labels.label: Onboarding & KYC
labels.covers: FPI registration, account opening, KYC, signatories, UBO, FATCA/CRS and address changes.

labels.label: Complaint / escalation
labels.covers: The client is unhappy, threatens to move, suspects fraud or asks for a senior person. Overrides the topic.

queries.text: Our auditor wants a balance confirmation of all securities held with you as of 31 March. Who do we write to?
queries.label: Statement request
queries.note: No 'statement' word; it is still a reporting request.

queries.text: Can you resend last week's contract notes? Our auditors are asking for them.
queries.label: Statement request

queries.text: Your team missed our buyback tender. We want to speak to your head of operations.
queries.label: Complaint / escalation
queries.note: 'Buyback' pulls it to Corporate action, but the client wants a senior person.

queries.text: Any update on our FPI registration?
queries.label: Onboarding & KYC

queries.text: Please confirm the CP code mapping for trades placed through our new broker.
queries.label: Settlement status
queries.note: Jargon a newcomer may not know.

queries.text: When will the HDFC Bank dividend be credited to our account?
queries.label: Corporate action

queries.text: Our UBO details changed after the restructuring. How do we update them?
queries.label: Onboarding & KYC

queries.text: The TDS deducted on the interim dividend looks higher than the treaty rate. Can you check?
queries.label: Corporate action
queries.note: Mentions tax, which can pull it towards billing.

queries.text: We need the transaction statement for Q2 in Excel, not PDF.
queries.label: Statement request

queries.text: We've moved offices. Where do we send proof of the new registered address?
queries.label: Onboarding & KYC
queries.note: No KYC word; an address change is a KYC update.

queries.text: The shares we bought on Monday still haven't reached our demat account. Why?
queries.label: Settlement status
queries.note: Sounds annoyed, but it is a status question, not a complaint yet.

queries.text: What is the cut-off time for T+0 trades today?
queries.label: Settlement status

queries.text: Kindly share the capital gains report for FY 2025-26 for the PMS book.
queries.label: Statement request
queries.note: Report, not a tax or billing query.

queries.text: Has yesterday's sale of 5,000 TCS shares settled?
queries.label: Settlement status

queries.text: We need to add a new authorised signatory to the account.
queries.label: Onboarding & KYC

queries.text: Someone emailed asking us to change our bank account details. Was that really from you?
queries.label: Complaint / escalation
queries.note: Possible fraud: must go to a person, not to KYC.

queries.text: Statement for quarter end, please.
queries.label: Statement request
queries.note: Short and informal; 'statement' still gives it away.

queries.text: When will the money come in? The dividend credit is still not showing.
queries.label: Corporate action

queries.text: We were charged twice on the September invoice.
queries.label: Fees & billing
queries.note: Invoice error, but no anger: billing, not complaint.

queries.text: The split shares from ITC are not reflecting in our demat yet.
queries.label: Corporate action
queries.note: Sounds like settlement ('demat'), but it is a corporate action.

queries.text: Please send the FATCA and CRS self-certification forms for the new feeder fund.
queries.label: Onboarding & KYC
queries.note: Forms, but for onboarding, not reporting.

queries.text: Fix this today or we move custodians.
queries.label: Complaint / escalation
queries.note: No topic words at all, only the threat.

queries.text: Can you send a revised invoice with our GSTIN corrected?
queries.label: Fees & billing
queries.note: GSTIN can look like KYC; it is an invoice fix.

queries.text: I want to make a statement: your team lost our rights entitlement.
queries.label: Complaint / escalation

queries.text: What is the record date for the Reliance bonus issue?
queries.label: Corporate action

queries.text: Please share your fee schedule for fund accounting services.
queries.label: Fees & billing

queries.text: Is there a charge for manual settlement instructions?
queries.label: Fees & billing
queries.note: Mentions settlement, but asks about a charge.

queries.text: How much do we need to fund for tomorrow's pay-in?
queries.label: Settlement status

queries.text: Please send the holding statement for our FPI account as on 30 September.
queries.label: Statement request

queries.text: The broker delivered short. Is there an auction risk on our trade?
queries.label: Settlement status
queries.note: Short delivery and auction are settlement terms.

queries.text: Has the Infosys buyback tender been accepted for our holding?
queries.label: Corporate action

queries.text: What documents do you need for the KYC refresh?
queries.label: Onboarding & KYC

queries.text: Why is the custody fee higher this month?
queries.label: Fees & billing

queries.text: The fee you charged for the failed trade is unfair and we want it waived. Our board is reviewing the mandate.
queries.label: Complaint / escalation
queries.note: Trap: 'fee' points to Billing, but the mandate is at risk.

queries.text: This is the third failed trade this month. This is unacceptable.
queries.label: Complaint / escalation

queries.text: The basis-point charge on our assets under custody doesn't match the agreement.
queries.label: Fees & billing

You people lost money for our investors.
